klipler.istem: Slow camera push-in toward the cracked shell, the pale-amber new layer along the crack glows softly and light shimmers on the shell, a water drop slides down the leaf. Snail stays still. 3D animation style preserved.
Gentle ripples move across the pond, golden light sparkles on the water, lily pads sway slightly, mist drifts. Slow camera glide forward. 3D animation style preserved.
